description_en: You can invoke ListAttempts to obtain the list of contact dialing records for a specified predictive outbound calling Activity under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListAttempts获取指定实例下指定预测式外呼活动的联系人拨打记录列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-attempts --instance-id ccc-test --campaign-id 6badb397-a8b5-40b6-21019d382a09 --start-time 1634115688291 --end-time 1634115698291 --queue-id skillgroup@ccc-test --case-id 60ecb1a2-4480-4d01-bede-c5b7655bfadf --attempt-id job-169769645003250000 --contact-id job-169769645003250000 --agent-id agent@ccc-test --caller 057112340000 --callee 18888880000 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --criteria caseIds_:_964f05a7-fc15-4a05-93a6-cd7421c4459e_,_5e2d508b-0df6-4077-8099-d3fff51ea6d0_,_da037029-8c83-4270-a90e-e7734be76af6 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAttempts
